content: Honey never spoils. Archaeologists have found 3,000-year-old honey in Egyptian tombs that was still perfectly edible. The low moisture content and natural hydrogen peroxide make it essentially immortal.

Octopuses have three hearts, blue blood, and a distributed nervous system — about two-thirds of their neurons are in their arms, not their brains. Each arm can taste, feel, and make simple decisions independently.
A day on Venus is longer than a year on Venus. It takes 243 Earth days to rotate once on its axis, but only 225 Earth days to orbit the Sun. On Venus, the year ends before the day does.
There are more possible arrangements of moves in a game of chess than there are atoms in the observable universe. After just four moves each, there are over 288 billion possible games.
Cleopatra lived closer in time to the Moon landing than to the construction of the Great Pyramid. The pyramids were built around 2560 BCE; Cleopatra died in 30 BCE; the Moon landing was in 1969 CE.
Oxford University is older than the Aztec Empire. Teaching began at Oxford around 1096. The Aztec Empire wasn't founded until roughly 1428 — more than three centuries later.

Bananas are technically berries, but strawberries are not. Botanically, a berry develops from a single flower with one ovary. Strawberries develop from a flower with multiple ovaries, making them "aggregate fruits."
The fingerprints of koalas are virtually indistinguishable from human fingerprints, even under a microscope. They are one of only three non-primate animals known to have them.

Trees in forests share nutrients and chemical warning signals through underground fungal networks sometimes called the "wood wide web." Older trees have been observed sending extra carbon to the seedlings of their own species.
The total biomass of all ants on Earth is roughly comparable to the total biomass of all humans. There are an estimated 20 quadrillion ants alive today — about 2.5 million per person.

A group of flamingos is called a flamboyance. A group of crows is called a murder. A group of owls is called a parliament. A group of cats is called a clowder. English has always been deeply concerned with naming gatherings.

The smell of rain on dry earth has a name: petrichor. It comes from a combination of plant oils and a compound called geosmin produced by soil bacteria. Humans can detect geosmin at concentrations as low as 5 parts per trillion.
